scope: EVM chain identity and transient RPC TLS recovery observation
doesNotClaim: Wallet connection, signing, transaction, or Product Session success
rules: A Gateway/Product Session error must not be projected as a Standard Wallet disconnection or a public-chain Offline condition.
Only accepted Device Proof, protocol, expiry/clock and gateway categories are mapped from Gateway responses.
RPC recovery following an observed TLS error is reported as degraded with RPC_TRANSIENT_TLS_FAILURE, not as a Gateway error.
A successful eth_chainId result that differs from 6423 is EVM_CHAIN_MISMATCH.
HTTP 410 or CLIENT_RETIRED is CLIENT_RETIRED, not Offline.
Public responses expose only HTTPS origins and validated source commit/release/start time fields.
consumerActivation: Requires Integration acceptance and a signed, accepted public endpoint manifest before public production activation.
